entities.summary: Alexi Jose Amarista is a Venezuelan professional baseball utility player for the Guerreros de Oaxaca of the Mexican League. Amarista was signed by the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim as an amateur free agent in 2007. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Angels, San Diego Padres, and Colorado Rockies.
